description: This file contains integration tests for the Loan Product over-applied amount feature in the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating and modifying loan products with over-applied amounts, and validates behaviors such as disbursing amounts exceeding approved limits, as well as ensuring correct system responses and settings.

classes.name: LoanProductOverAppliedAmountTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the over-applied amount features related to loan products in the Fineract system.

methods.name: testCreateMultiDisburseLoanProductWithOverAppliedAmountAndExpectedTranches
methods.description: Tests creation of a multi-disburse loan product with over-applied amount allowed and verifies its settings after creation.

methods.name: testModifyMultiDisburseLoanProductWithOverAppliedAmountAndExpectedTranches
methods.description: Tests modification of an existing loan product to enable over-applied amount and verifies the updated settings.

methods.name: testAvailableDisbursementAmountNotNegativeWhenDisbursedAmountExceedsApprovedAmount
methods.description: Tests that the available disbursement amount does not become negative when disbursed amount exceeds the approved amount with over-applied enabled.
